# Plugin catalogue

<!-- Generated by build/build_plugins.py from build/templates/plugins-catalogue.md — do not edit. -->

Version 0.1.0. Add the marketplace once, then install what you want:

```
/plugin marketplace add sphexi/claude-code-kit
/plugin install <plugin>@sphexi
```

- [`sphexi-core`](#sphexi-core) — Thirteen specialist subagents; the systematic-debugging, code-comments, test-discipline and skill-creator skills; three terseness output styles; and a session-start hook that applies the comment and test standards.
- [`sphexi-review`](#sphexi-review) — Code review, refactoring, testing and debugging: multi-perspective review, PR review agents, feature-dev workflow, TDD cycle, unit testing and accessibility audits.
- [`sphexi-security`](#sphexi-security) — Security review: SAST, threat modelling, compliance checks, API and frontend hardening, dependency audits.
- [`sphexi-python`](#sphexi-python) — Modern Python: python-pro, FastAPI and Django agents plus Python pattern skills.
- [`sphexi-languages`](#sphexi-languages) — Bash and POSIX shell, Go, and general developer skills (git, error handling, auth, SQL, e2e testing).
- [`sphexi-backend`](#sphexi-backend) — Backend architecture, API scaffolding, database design and migrations, and full-stack feature orchestration.
- [`sphexi-infra`](#sphexi-infra) — Cloud architecture, Kubernetes, Terraform, service mesh and CI/CD pipelines.
- [`sphexi-ai`](#sphexi-ai) — LLM application development: RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering and LLM evaluation.
- `twingate-assistant` — Twingate zero trust network access: architecture, deployment, infrastructure as code and troubleshooting. Maintained in its own repository, whose reference docs are synced against Twingate's live documentation.

Each plugin section below lists every agent, command, skill, output style and hook it ships. **Custom** components are written for this kit. **Vendored** components are copied from the upstream plugin named in the Source column, under that plugin's license; see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for attribution and the files changed from upstream. Descriptions are cut from each component's own frontmatter.

## sphexi-core

Thirteen specialist subagents; the systematic-debugging, code-comments, test-discipline and skill-creator skills; three terseness output styles; and a session-start hook that applies the comment and test standards.

- Install: `/plugin install sphexi-core@sphexi`
- Dependencies: none
- License: MIT AND Apache-2.0
- Contents: 13 agents, 4 skills

### Agents

| Name | What it does | Origin | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bash-powershell-engineer` | Writes and fixes shell scripts. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `docker-engineer` | Writes and fixes Dockerfiles, docker-compose.yml and .dockerignore. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `docs-writer` | Human-readable documentation: README, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, architecture decision records, OpenAPI reference text, docstring and comment passes (including cutting excess prose), ticking off… | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `frontend-engineer` | Browser-facing UI for Python-backed services: Jinja2 templates, hand-written CSS, vanilla JavaScript, status pages, admin UIs and form flows served by Django, Flask, aiohttp or similar. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `integration-test-runner` | End-to-end test pipeline — unit tests, Docker image build, container start, integration tests against the live container, log validation, and a structured pass/fail report. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `networking-engineer` | Networking configuration and troubleshooting — Docker and compose networking, port publishing, DNS, proxies and NO_PROXY, TLS certificates and custom CAs, firewall rules, reverse proxies (nginx,… | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `project-architect` | Owns project design and the canonical project documents. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `python-engineer` | Python implementation work: writing or editing Python source, including async business logic, Pydantic models and settings, httpx usage, structlog logging, schedulers and sync engines. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `rest-api-engineer` | Integrating external REST APIs from async Python: translating API documentation into a client class, OAuth2 flows (authorization code, client credentials, device flow), token storage and refresh,… | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `rust-engineer` | General application-level Rust — async services on tokio, HTTP clients and servers (reqwest, axum), CLIs (clap), serde, sqlx/sea-orm, error types, Cargo workspaces and crate setup. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `rust-systems-engineer` | Low-level, performance-critical Rust — DNS protocol implementation (wire parsing, DoH/DoT/DoQ), raw UDP/TCP listeners and connection pools, zero-copy parsing, lock-free structures, unsafe blocks,… | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `task-orchestrator` | Plans and coordinates a project's session work. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `test-engineer` | Writing and maintaining pytest suites and everything under tests/: test files, fixtures and conftest.py, respx mocks for httpx, async tests, markers and pytest config, suite sizing, pruning and… | Custom | this kit | MIT |

### Skills

| Name | What it does | Origin | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code-comments` | The minimal comment model — what a comment must say, what it must never contain, and how much of it is allowed. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `skill-creator` | Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. | Vendored | `skill-creator` from [anthropics/claude-plugins-official](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official) | Apache-2.0 |
| `systematic-debugging` | Root-cause-before-fix debugging methodology. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `test-discipline` | How much to test, how to keep a suite fast, and how to run it during a session without burning the session on re-runs. | Custom | this kit | MIT |

### Output styles

| Name | What it does | Origin | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Terse (Full)` | The answer, and only the answer. Sentence fragments acceptable. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `Terse (Low)` | Answer first, no preamble, no recap. Full sentences, reasoning retained where it is load-bearing. | Custom | this kit | MIT |
| `Terse (Medium)` | The answer plus the one thing needed to act on it. Background only when asked. | Custom | this kit | MIT |

| Name | What it does | Origin | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
